item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01300","case1_error":"States 19 after correct formulas without showing their evaluation; the correct answer is 9.","case2_error":"Treats the tripled forest total as newly planted trees, failing to subtract the original 30.","reason":"An unsupported final number differs from an explicitly incorrect relation between existing and newly planted trees.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01301","case1_error":"Reports one shortened segment’s length, 5 inches, rather than the joined rope’s length, 15 inches.","case2_error":"Omits Jacob’s 18 hours from the total for all three people.","reason":"The first answers an intermediate length; the second forms an incomplete sum for the requested total.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01302","case1_error":"Adds the brownies given to Carl and Simon and labels that amount as brownies remaining.","case2_error":"Identifies Robert as Bob; whether this is erroneous depends on whether the names denote the same person.","reason":"The first clearly substitutes gifts for leftovers. The second is ambiguous because Bob can be a nickname for Robert.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01303","case1_error":"Uses one Monday count in Tuesday’s total instead of the stated two Tuesday tile counts.","case2_error":"Gives 2500 after correct formulas without showing an evaluation; those formulas yield 4500.","reason":"The first explicitly selects an incorrect count from the wrong day; the second supplies an unsupported number after a correct setup.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01304","case1_error":"Subtracts only two duplicate movie counts, although two movies counted three times require subtracting four.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 8 + 12 + 16 + 4 as 30 instead of 40.","reason":"The first uses an incorrect overlap correction; the second numerically miscalculates a correctly written sum.","judgment":"different"}]}
